name: Upward Bound at Elgin Community College
what_you_do: Free college prep for high school students: advising, educational workshops, tutoring, field trips and college courses, plus fee waivers for college applications and SAT/ACT.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12 at Dundee-Crown, Larkin or Streamwood High School who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents and are either potential first-generation college students or from a low-income household (U.S. Department of Education rules). If unsure, apply and staff will tell you if you qualify.
pay_detail: Free program. No stipend mentioned on the page.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Student and parent or guardian complete the online Upward Bound application. Counselors and teachers can fill out the Student Recommendation Form. Contact: upwardbound@elgin.edu, 847-214-7253, Building K, Room K102, 1700 Spartan Drive, Elgin.
notes: Only for students at the three listed high schools. The page does not mention a summer part or a start date, so ask staff. A web search snippet suggested Elgin High School is also served, but the ECC page itself lists only the three above.
